new_findings.kind: flatten invariant: content survives on a flattened page (pdf.js inherits /Annots through /Parent)
new_findings.file_line: src/flatten.rs:479-498 (flattened page rebuilt WITHOUT an /Annots key while /Parent is kept, :481-483); src/flatten.rs:451 (only the page's own /Annots is noted); src/redaction.rs:1069 (selector reads only the page's own /Annots); src/flatten.rs:515 and :64 (check_flattened whitelists the page dictionary's own keys and never reads the /Parent chain); src/pdf_edit.rs:218-262 (walk_pages accepts /Annots on /Pages nodes)
new_findings.evidence: pdf.js da95557 src/core/document.js:808-810 `get annotations() { const annots = this.#getInheritableProperty("Annots"); ... }` and core_utils.js:154-177 (getInheritableProperty walks /Parent; with no /Annots on the page the first value found is the parent's). Counterexample: 2 = << /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 /Annots [20 0 R] >>; 3 = page drawing 'BT /F1 12 Tf 72 300 Td (Public) Tj ET'; 20 = << /Type /Annot /Subtype /FreeText /Rect [90 690 200 715] /AP << /N 21 0 R >> >>, 21 = form /BBox [0 0 110 25] /Resources << /Font << /F1 Helvetica >> >> drawing 'BT /F1 12 Tf 2 8 Td (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET'. redact_and_save(page 0, [90 690 200 715], Refuse): the selector sees no annotation (nothing removed, no needle), flatten rebuilds object 3 with /Parent 2 0 R and no /Annots, save_full keeps node 2 and its /Annots (reachable), check_flattened passes (keys within PAGE_KEYS, raster region black): region_flattened() true (and region_cleared()/is_proven() true: SECRET-ALPHA is not a needle), while pdf.js draws annotation 20 over the raster, SECRET-ALPHA inside the region. Contradicts DESCRIPTOR redaction.flatten.region_clearing ('whatever any reader draws on the page ... the page holds nothing else') and flatten.rs:3-11.
new_findings.remediation: Write /Annots [] on every flattened page (pdf.js then stops at the page's own empty array; allow the key in PAGE_KEYS only with an empty array value) or remove /Annots from every /Pages node on the path; have check_flattened walk the /Parent chain and fail on any inherited /Annots (and any key a viewer inherits that is not overridden); have the selector treat inherited /Annots as the page's annotations; add the counterexample as a test (pdf.js-style inheritance read with hayro-syntax plus an explicit parent-chain check).

new_findings.kind: renderer differential that ADDS content: optional content hidden by the document's default configuration is drawn into the raster
new_findings.file_line: src/flatten.rs:313-315 (isolated catalog holds only /Type /Catalog /Pages, no /OCProperties); src/flatten.rs:22-23 ('it can never add content'); src/paint.rs:9-10 ('absent content can only remove information, never add it'); src/lib.rs:93 DESCRIPTOR redaction.flatten.fails_safe ('absent content only removes information')
new_findings.evidence: hayro-interpret 0.7.0 src/context.rs:87-92 builds OcgState from the catalog of the document it renders (the isolated one), src/ocg.rs:18-24 returns the dummy state (no inactive group) when the catalog has no /OCProperties, so every /OC BDC, form /OC and image /OC is visible; pdf.js, MuPDF and Acrobat honour /OCProperties /D /OFF (and /BaseState /OFF). Counterexample: source catalog /OCProperties << /OCGs [50 0 R] /D << /OFF [50 0 R] >> >>, page content '/OC /L1 BDC BT /F1 12 Tf 72 100 Td (SALARY 95000) Tj ET EMC' with /Properties << /L1 50 0 R >>, a region elsewhere on the page: every viewer hides SALARY 95000 in the source; the flattened raster draws it visibly outside the region (not a needle, nothing reports it). The same class: an occluder the rasteriser skips (pattern or shading paint, a soft-masked group, content past the clip-depth or work caps; FlattenNote) uncovers what it covered, so 'absent content only removes information' is false for occluded content.
new_findings.remediation: Copy the source catalog's /OCProperties (and what it reaches; object numbers are kept by isolate) into the isolated catalog, or refuse/mark when the page uses /OC and the document has /OCProperties; weaken the three doc claims (absent content can uncover what it occluded) or treat any FlattenNote on a page as NotProven/report it; test with an /OFF group outside the region.

new_findings.kind: renderer boundary (V4-01): unbounded recursion inside hayro-syntax aborts the process (stack overflow is not a panic; catch_unwind does not catch it)
new_findings.file_line: src/redaction.rs:854-876 (the selector parses a form only when its box touches the region: other forms never reach content::parse_strict); src/flatten.rs:228-268 and :272-339 (isolate copies every reachable stream decoded, without parsing content); src/flatten.rs:349-374 (catch_unwind is the only guard)
new_findings.evidence: hayro-syntax 0.7.2 src/object/array.rs:72-86 (Array::skip loops r.skip::<Object>), src/object/mod.rs:163-180 (Object::skip calls Array::skip / Dict::skip again for '[' / '<<'), src/object/dict.rs:160-184, src/content/mod.rs:142 (every content operand read through Object::read -> Array::read -> skip, :97 of array.rs); grep finds no depth limit in hayro-syntax 0.7.2 (only MAX_XREF_CHAIN_DEPTH). hayro-interpret 0.7.0 src/x_object.rs:103-176 draw_form_xobject interprets every drawn form without culling. Counterexample: page content 'q /Fm1 Do Q BT /F1 12 Tf 100 700 Td (SECRET-ALPHA) Tj ET', /Fm1 = form /BBox [0 0 10 10] at the origin (outside region [90 690 200 715], so the selector never parses it) whose content is 1,000,000 '[' bytes (1 MB, within max_decoded_bytes): redact_and_save under the default Refuse policy reaches render(); hayro recurses about 1e6 levels and overflows the thread stack: the process aborts (Rust 'has overflowed its stack', not unwinding), losing the host application. Same for Type 3 glyph procedures and forms past depth 8 under ReportAndContinue. Not executed (no cargo in this review); constructed from the code paths above.
new_findings.remediation: Before rendering, strict-parse (content::parse_strict, depth-capped) every content stream the isolated page can reach (forms at any depth, Type 3 procedures, tiling patterns, soft-mask groups) and give the renderer an EMPTY stream (FlattenNote::UndecodableStream) or refuse when it fails; or pre-scan every decoded stream of the isolated document for '[' / '<<' nesting deeper than HARD_MAX_DEPTH; add a test with a deeply nested form outside the region; list the renderer's recursion as a residual if any path stays unscanned.

new_findings.kind: renderer boundary (V4-02): the image budget misses inline images and abbreviated /W /H, and hayro allocates width x height x components regardless of the data length
new_findings.file_line: src/flatten.rs:294-302 (ImageBudget: only stream OBJECTS whose resolved /Subtype is /Image, only the keys /Width and /Height, pixels compared with max_decoded_bytes); src/content.rs:353-378 (exact_end: an inline image's /W /H are bounded only for unfiltered data, raw_length :254; for a raster codec (:358-374) and for Flate and the other filters (:376, first stage only) they are not); DESCRIPTOR redaction.flatten.refusals 'image_budget (an image of the page declares more pixels than Limits::max_decoded_bytes)'
new_findings.evidence: hayro-interpret 0.7.0 src/x_object.rs:320-321 reads /W or /Width and /H or /Height for XObjects AND inline images; src/interpret/mod.rs:668-681 draws inline images; src/x_object.rs:514-591 decode_raster: for any /BitsPerComponent other than 8 (or a non-default /Decode or a transfer function) get_components (:902-922) loops height x width x components pushing one u16 each (missing data read as 0) BEFORE fix_image_length; zune-jpeg 0.5.15 decoder.rs:215-218 allocates width x height x components for DCT data whose SOF dims hayro accepts up to 65535 (hayro-syntax 0.7.2 filter/dct.rs:16-30). Counterexamples (not executed): (a) inline image 'BI /W 65535 /H 65535 /BPC 1 /CS /DeviceCMYK /F /Fl ID <small zlib stream> EI' anywhere on a region's page (a painted class in the region, untouched outside it): the crate's parse bounds only the Flate first stage; hayro pushes 65535 x 65535 x 4 = 1.7e10 u16 (about 34 GB) and the allocation fails (abort) after tens of seconds of uncancellable CPU; (b) an image XObject spelled << /Subtype /Image /W 65535 /H 65535 /BPC 1 /CS /DeviceCMYK >> with one data byte: flatten.rs:297 reads /Width and /Height as 0 and passes it; (c) inside the budget, a 64 Mi-pixel CMYK image at /BPC 4 still costs about 0.5 GB of u16 plus 1 GB of f32 in hayro. Lane notes.d27_flatten.research_basis risks list only 'CPU time inside hayro' as residual; the DESCRIPTOR lists none.
new_findings.remediation: Apply the image budget to every image hayro can decode (inline images of every content stream the isolated page reaches, /W /H abbreviations, /SMask and /Mask images whatever their /Subtype) and size it as hayro allocates (pixels x components x (2 + 4 + 3) bytes against a renderer memory cap), refuse (ImageBudget) otherwise; add dims_u32_max tests for an inline image and an abbreviated XObject; list the remaining renderer CPU/memory residual in DESCRIPTOR.

new_findings.kind: painted_over sources survive in the file: an image or vector form drawn in the region stays verbatim when it is reachable through an inherited (or shared) resource dictionary, while the result is proven
new_findings.file_line: src/redaction.rs:1036-1041 (with flattening, Image/Vector/Shading/InlineImage are moved to painted_over and no longer refused; nothing is removed under Refuse/ReportAndContinue); src/flatten.rs:479-498 (only the page dictionary is rebuilt; the /Pages node holding the inherited /Resources is untouched); src/flatten.rs:4-7 ('none of its own resources are carried'); DESCRIPTOR proof.not_covered 'pixels of raster images (region removal of the image is the remedy)'
new_findings.evidence: Counterexample (code paths read, not executed): 2 = << /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 /Resources << /XObject << /Im1 10 0 R >> >> >>; 3 = page without /Resources drawing 'q 612 0 0 792 0 0 cm /Im1 Do Q'; 10 = full-page scan (DCT or Flate) whose pixels show SECRET-ALPHA inside region [90 690 200 715]. redact_and_save(page 0, region, Refuse): the selector resolves /Im1 through the inherited resources (redaction.rs:1024 inherited 'Resources', :549-552), marks Image, flattening moves it to painted_over (not refused, report complete); flatten rebuilds page 3 with its own /Resources (HskFl0) but node 2 still lists /Im1, so save_full keeps object 10 byte for byte; no needle exists, a DCT image is a raster_stream that does not block, Flate pixels are not text: region_flattened(), region_cleared() and is_proven() are true while any image extractor (pdfimages, Acrobat 'export images') recovers the unredacted scan. The same holds for a vector form (a drawn signature) listed in an inherited /Resources. Before D27 an image under a region was refused under Refuse (UnsupportedRedactionClass Image) or left the region not proven; D27 made the painted classes 'complete' without removing their sources.
new_findings.remediation: On every flattened page, remove from the file every XObject/shading/pattern the selector marked as painted in a region (or simply every resource the old page could reach) unless a page that is not flattened draws it: copy inherited /Resources down to the sibling pages and drop the entries from the /Pages nodes, or refuse (or add a NotProven reason) when such an object stays reachable; test with an inherited-resource scan and with a shared form.
